prompt_and_parser: Official DTS Muir task, including strict initial A. extraction fallback to raw stripped response
objectives: Audit baseline behavior on an independent development dataset
Compare counterpart-pair accuracy and task groups
Identify failure mechanisms; no test-set method selection
limitations: Fixed example scaling is not established as the paper's 7B optimal setting
Development split does not contain Ordering examples; no generalization claim for that task
Canonical-start is not expanded to Muir: initial mechanism pilot lacked supporting evidence
